observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
The existing photos still do not show a clearly readable brand/model label, battery capacity, or any runtime/charging indicator.

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: No readable 'Qasa' branding/model text is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low.
claims.evidence: Seller claims testing, but no runtime test video/timer or battery indicator is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No receipt/date or clear wear evidence is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos cannot confirm internal motor condition or whether it was opened.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: “I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.”
claims.evidence: This is seller text only; without new proof (video/photos), it cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Battery runtime may be less than claimed (battery health degradation).
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running on high from full charge with a visible timer/phone stopwatch, plus the charge indicator state (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as rechargeable fan with unknown/possibly reduced runtime (worst case: not meeting the claimed 2 hours).

risks.risk: Charging may be faulty or inconsistent (may not charge fully).
risks.proof: A video showing charging from near-empty to full (or showing indicator changes), then immediate operation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to charge properly until proven.

risks.risk: Fan performance issues (wobble, noise, weak airflow) not captured in still photos.
risks.proof: Short videos running on low and high showing stability and airflow strength (front + side angles).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average/possibly weak performance (worst case: not like new).

risks.risk: Brand/model uncertainty affects correct comparable pricing.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the hub/power module label with readable brand/model text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic rechargeable fan without confirmed brand/model.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the brand/model label on the hub or power module (readable text).
Send a timed runtime video: charge to full, then run on high with a visible timer/stopwatch.
Send a charging proof video: show charging progress/indicator and then start the fan immediately after full charge.
Send photos of the receipt and warranty card (with serial/date visible).
response.reason: The seller’s statement that they tested it is not verifiable remotely without a runtime/charging video and readable brand/model details. Until then, the item must be priced at worst-case assumptions for battery/charging performance.
